description: TfL publishes the highway-authority boundary for its A13 Design, Build, Finance and Operate arrangement. The snippet identifies a maintenance and operation concession managed on behalf of TfL, from Butcher Row to Wennington Interchange with adjoining sections. The polygon layer describes the contract’s geographic boundary. It does not provide contract cash flows, road condition or traffic performance, and exact boundary currency must be checked before operational use. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
